description: Make a sprite or a short animation made ANYWHERE (another AI tool, an artist, a screen recording) game-ready with Voidless's own clean-up: background removed with stray pieces checked (sparks and dust kept, smudges removed); pixel art put on a real pixel grid with one palette and stray pixels fixed. A 1-5 s video comes back as 16 frames: kind 'loop' cuts the cleanest loop (walk, run, idle), 'once' keeps the whole move (attack, jump). Saved to the user's library. Give the file as a public URL (best for videos) or base64. 1 free run a day (10 on Voidless+), then 1 credit an image, 2 a video. For a quick pixel-art version of an already clean image, pixelate_image is enough.

file.description: Base64 file instead of url (a data: prefix is stripped automatically)

kind.description: What the file is. Inferred from the url's extension when omitted

motion.description: Video only: loop = find the cleanest loop; once = keep the whole clip

size.description: Output size. Default 64 for pixel, 512 for smooth (smooth allows only 512 or 1024)

style.description: pixel = pixel art at 32-1024; smooth = clean cut-out at 512 or 1024

url.description: Public http(s) link to the image or video. Use this for videos

name: clean_up_sprite
